method: Reused the previously read full exam and visually inspected seven exam figures after verifying the identical document SHA-256. Screened final stems, options and feedback for new 12-word overlap, then compared cognitive tasks. Q23 supplies causal-mechanism calibration; Q30 is only an interest-sensitive-investment boundary cue.
limitation: Text overlap is a screen, not a proof of originality. Generic textbook terminology and retained preexisting content are not evidence of new copying.
